mapper.sql: id, rubric_key, name, version, description, enabled, created_by, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.rubric_key, r.name, r.version, r.description, r.enabled, r.created_by, r.created_at FROM review_rubric r JOIN (SELECT rubric_key, MAX(version) AS max_version FROM review_rubric WHERE enabled GROUP BY rubric_key) m ON r.rubric_key = m.rubric_key AND r.version = m.max_version WHERE r.enabled ORDER BY r.created_at
SELECT FROM review_rubric WHERE rubric_key = #{rubricKey} AND enabled ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM review_rubric WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM review_rubric WHERE rubric_key=#{rubricKey} ORDER BY version DESC
